definition: Relating to the abdomen or abdominal cavity, particularly used in medical contexts to describe the coeliac artery and related structures. In modern usage, it commonly refers to celiac disease, an autoimmune digestive disorder triggered by gluten consumption.
translation: 腹腔的；腹部的；（特別指）乳糜瀉（一種麩質不耐症）
example: People with celiac disease must avoid foods containing gluten to prevent intestinal damage.
